Third-party files served by DepotFlow itself (no CDN). All are copied unchanged from npm:

  alpine.min.js            Alpine.js 3.14.1  (dist/cdn.min.js)                MIT
  choices/choices.min.js   Choices.js 11.1.0 (public/assets/scripts)           MIT
  choices/choices.min.css  Choices.js 11.1.0 (public/assets/styles)            MIT
  ../fonts/*.woff2         Poppins and Inter via @fontsource                   SIL OFL 1.1
                           (licence texts: ../fonts/LICENSE-*.txt)

To upgrade one, download the new version from npm, replace the file, and update this list.
The site stylesheet (../css/tailwind.css) is built from assets/tailwind.input.css - see the header of that file.
